summary: Ukrainian drone strikes hit Russia's Engels strategic airbase and Yaroslavl refinery while sea drones attacked Russian shadow fleet tankers in the Black Sea. Russian Geran-4 drones struck four cargo ships in Odesa and Mykolaiv ports. Ukraine's defense minister Fedorov was dismissed amid protests, and Serhiy Koretskyi was confirmed as prime minister.
key_points: Ukrainian drones attacked Engels airbase, key base for Russian strategic aviation launching missile strikes on Ukraine (Source: @UkraineNow/82680)
Ukrainian drone swarm damaged reservoir park at Slavneft-YANOS refinery in Yaroslavl region (Source: @eRadarrua/101276)
SBU and Navy sea drones struck two Russian shadow fleet tankers in Black Sea; Russian aviation failed to intercept (Source: @UkraineNow/82689)
Russian Geran-4 drones hit four cargo ships in Chornomorsk and Dniprovsko-Bugsky ports (Odesa and Mykolaiv regions) (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31667)
Verkhovna Rada appointed Serhiy Koretskyi as prime minister with 289 votes; cabinet excludes defense and foreign ministers (Source: @UkraineNow/82693)
Defense Minister Fedorov dismissed after failing to implement TCC reform and disagreements with Commander-in-Chief Syrsky (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31658)
IAEA Director Grossi condemned killing of Zaporizhzhia NPP chief engineer Oleksandr Yakovlev in Ukrainian drone attack (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31660)
DeepState map shows Russian forces advanced near Dorozhnyi; ballistic missile threat from Taganrog and northeast (Source: @DeepStateUA/23645, @mon1tor_ua/69014, @kpszsu/68692)

sections.executive_summary: Ukrainian drone strikes hit Russia's Engels strategic airbase and Yaroslavl refinery while sea drones attacked Russian shadow fleet tankers in the Black Sea. Russian Geran-4 drones struck four cargo ships in Odesa and Mykolaiv ports. Ukraine's defense minister Fedorov was dismissed amid protests, and Serhiy Koretskyi was confirmed as prime minister.

points: Ukrainian drones attacked Engels airbase in Saratov region overnight, with some drones hitting residential buildings and others likely targeting the strategic aviation base that launches missile strikes on Ukraine (Source: @UkraineNow/82680). A Ukrainian drone swarm struck the Slavneft-YANOS refinery in Yaroslavl region, damaging a reservoir park at one of Putin's key oil facilities (Source: @eRadarrua/101276). The SBU jointly with the Navy struck two Russian shadow fleet tankers in the Black Sea using sea drones; Russian aviation attempted to destroy the drones with machine guns and bombs but failed (Source: @UkraineNow/82689). Defense Minister Fedorov resigned after Zelensky cited failure to implement TCC reform and disagreements with Commander-in-Chief Syrsky; Fedorov declined an advisor role and listed achievements including Starlink cutoff for Russians, drone procurement surge, logistic lockdown, and Patriot missile contracts (Source: @UkraineNow/82677, @ukr_leaks_eng/31658, @DeepStateUA/23646). Verkhovna Rada appointed Naftogaz head Serhiy Koretskyi as prime minister with 289 votes; the new cabinet lacks defense and foreign ministers, with Zelensky to nominate candidates later (Source: @UkraineNow/82693, @ukr_leaks_eng/31665). Protests erupted in support of Fedorov with chants demanding Syrsky's resignation; Deputy Air Forces Commander Pavlo Yelizarov resigned in protest, calling Fedorov's dismissal 'great evil for defense capability' (Source: @tass_agency/385541, @DeepStateUA/23653). Air defenses intercepted at least two ballistic missiles over Kyiv and engaged 10 Shahed drones over Kharkiv; multiple jet UAVs tracked across Kharkiv, Poltava, Dnipropetrovsk, Mykolaiv, and Sumy regions (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69004, @kpszsu/68691, @eRadarrua/101266, @kpszsu/68719, @kpszsu/68707, @kpszsu/68663, @eRadarrua/101242).

Russian Geran-4 drones struck four cargo ships in the ports of Chornomorsk and Dniprovsko-Bugsky located in Odesa and Mykolaiv regions, according to Russian Ministry of Defense reports (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31667, @ukr_leaks_eng/31653). Russian ballistic missile threat detected from Taganrog area with Iskander-M systems; additional threat of ballistic weapons from northeast direction (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69014, @kpszsu/68692). Dutch police found evidence at the desecration of a Soviet soldiers' cemetery in the Netherlands; investigation ongoing with no arrests yet (Source: @tass_agency/385539). Russian embassy in Netherlands demanded swift investigation into the cemetery desecration (Source: @tass_agency/385537). A new prisoner exchange between Russia and Ukraine is expected soon, though the date remains undisclosed per Russian official Lantratova (Source: @tass_agency/385531). Russian air defense engaged Ukrainian drones over Engels airbase and Yaroslavl refinery; some drones reportedly hit residential buildings in Engels (Source: @UkraineNow/82680). Russian aviation attempted to intercept Ukrainian sea drones in the Black Sea using machine guns and bombs but without success (Source: @UkraineNow/82689).

DeepState map updated showing Russian forces advanced near Dorozhnyi settlement (Source: @DeepStateUA/23645). No specific unit names, distances, or casualty figures provided in the map update. The advance indicates continued pressure in the eastern sector but lacks operational details on axes or formations involved. Ukrainian defensive positions in the area are not described in the source. The map update is the only explicit frontline change reported for the eastern front in this dataset.

Ballistic missile threat reported from Taganrog area (Rostov region) with Iskander-M systems, indicating potential strike capability against northern Ukrainian regions (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69014). Additional threat of ballistic weapons from northeast direction noted by monitoring channels (Source: @kpszsu/68692). Jet UAVs tracked moving westward past Stary Merchik in Kharkiv region and northwestward in Kharkiv region near Kupyansk and Mala Danylivka (Source: @eRadarrua/101266, @eRadarrua/101275). Barrage munition 'Banderyol' observed on northwesterly course in Kharkiv region (Source: @kpszsu/68712). At least 10 Shahed drones targeted Kharkiv region overnight (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69004). No ground force movements or specific unit engagements reported for the northern front in these messages.

SBU and Navy sea drones struck two Russian shadow fleet tankers in the Black Sea; Russian aviation attempted interception with machine guns and bombs unsuccessfully (Source: @UkraineNow/82689). Russian Geran-4 drones hit four cargo ships in Chornomorsk and Dniprovsko-Bugsky ports (Odesa and Mykolaiv regions) carrying military goods per Russian MoD (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31667, @ukr_leaks_eng/31653). Jet UAVs launched from Black Sea waters toward Mykolaiv region and Odesa (Lymanka) observed (Source: @kpszsu/68695, @kpszsu/68700). Guided UAV from sea area toward Vylkove (Odesa region) and two UAVs in Sumy region heading toward Novgorod-Siverskyi, likely reconnaissance (Source: @eRadarrua/101242). Jet UAV in Mykolaiv district moving northward (Source: @kpszsu/68663). No ground combat details or territorial changes reported for southern front.

Ukrainian drone attack on Engels airbase (Saratov region) overnight; some drones hit residential buildings, others likely targeted strategic aviation base launching missile strikes on Ukraine (Source: @UkraineNow/82680). Ukrainian drone swarm struck Slavneft-YANOS refinery in Yaroslavl region, damaging reservoir park (Source: @eRadarrua/101276). Russian Geran-4 drones struck four cargo ships in Odesa and Mykolaiv ports (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31667). At least two ballistic missiles intercepted over Kyiv; 10 Shahed drones targeted Kharkiv (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69004). Multiple jet UAVs tracked across Kharkiv, Poltava, Dnipropetrovsk, Mykolaiv, Sumy regions on various courses (Source: @kpszsu/68691, @eRadarrua/101266, @kpszsu/68719, @eRadarrua/101275, @kpszsu/68707, @kpszsu/68663, @eRadarrua/101242). Barrage munition 'Banderyol' observed in Kharkiv and Mykolaiv/Odesa directions (Source: @kpszsu/68712, @kpszsu/68700). Threat of Iskander-M ballistic missile launch from Taganrog (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69014). Fedorov's farewell noted air defense interception rates increased from 83% to 91% for drones and 47% to 87% for cruise missiles after integrating Pavel Lazar into Air Forces and implementing After Action Reviews (Source: @DeepStateUA/23646).

key_developments: Ukrainian drones struck Engels strategic airbase in Saratov region and Yaroslavl refinery, demonstrating deep-strike capability against Russian strategic aviation and energy infrastructure (Source: @UkraineNow/82680, @eRadarrua/101276)
SBU and Navy sea drones attacked two Russian shadow fleet tankers in Black Sea; Russian air defense failed to intercept despite using machine guns and bombs (Source: @UkraineNow/82689)
Russian Geran-4 drones hit four cargo ships in Chornomorsk and Dniprovsko-Bugsky ports (Odesa/Mykolaiv), escalating port infrastructure targeting (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31667)

Defense Minister Fedorov dismissed over TCC reform failure and conflict with Commander-in-Chief Syrsky; Deputy Air Forces Commander Yelizarov resigned in protest (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31658, @DeepStateUA/23653)
Verkhovna Rada confirmed Serhiy Koretskyi as prime minister with 289 votes; new cabinet lacks defense and foreign ministers pending Zelensky nominations (Source: @UkraineNow/82693)
IAEA Director Grossi condemned killing of Zaporizhzhia NPP chief engineer Oleksandr Yakovlev in Ukrainian drone attack, warning of nuclear safety threat (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31660)
DeepState map shows Russian advance near Dorozhnyi; ballistic missile threats from Taganrog (Iskander-M) and northeast direction persist (Source: @DeepStateUA/23645, @mon1tor_ua/69014, @kpszsu/68692)
sections.threat_assessment: Ukraine's demonstrated ability to strike strategic Russian targets deep inside Russia — Engels airbase and Yaroslavl refinery — alongside effective sea drone operations against naval assets, signals a significant escalation in asymmetric warfare capabilities. Russia's retaliatory strikes on Ukrainian port infrastructure with Geran-4 drones and persistent ballistic missile threats from multiple axes indicate a continued focus on degrading Ukraine's logistics and economic lifelines. The political crisis triggered by Fedorov's dismissal, including senior military resignations and public protests, risks undermining command cohesion at a critical juncture. The killing of Zaporizhzhia NPP's chief engineer adds nuclear safety risks to an already volatile operational environment. Upcoming prisoner exchange may provide a brief diplomatic channel but unlikely to alter military trajectories.
sections.regional_response: Estonia's proposal to strip IOC of EU funding over Russia's sports return reflects continued European political pressure on Russian international engagement. Dutch investigation into Soviet cemetery desecration shows ongoing sensitivity to historical memory issues in Europe. The Verkhovna Rada's swift confirmation of Koretskyi as prime minister with 289 votes indicates parliamentary stability despite ministerial vacancies. Protests supporting Fedorov and demanding Syrsky's resignation reveal domestic tensions over military leadership. No direct NATO or partner military responses mentioned in the current message set.
sections.intelligence_notes: The coordinated Ukrainian strikes across air, sea, and land domains suggest improved integration of long-range strike capabilities and intelligence-surveillance-reconnaissance. Fedorov's listed achievements — including Starlink disruption for Russian forces, drone procurement surge, logistic lockdown, and Patriot/Gripen contracts — outline a modernization trajectory now potentially disrupted by his removal. The absence of defense and foreign ministers in the new cabinet creates decision-making gaps. Russian use of Geran-4 drones against port targets indicates adaptation of loitering munitions for maritime strike roles. Monitoring channels' tracking of multiple UAV types across broad fronts implies persistent Ukrainian air penetration. The IAEA's specific condemnation of the Zaporizhzhia engineer's death highlights international concern over nuclear facility targeting.
